instructions.content: Make Vite defer to Nx for path resolution and task orchestration through nxViteTsPaths(); without it workspace aliases resolve to nothing.
Keep workspace-level decisions in project.json and build-level decisions in vite.config.ts, separate from each other.
Treat library mode differently from app mode: libraries externalize peer deps, apps bundle everything.
Install @nx/vite and vite, plus one framework plugin (react, vue or svelte), in an Nx workspace.
Generate the Vite setup with nx g @nx/vite:configuration <project-name>.
Ensure build, serve and test (Vitest) targets are valid.
ALWAYS configure outDir and cacheDir relative to the workspace root.
Add nxCopyAssetsPlugin if non-public files must be copied.
Add an environment replacement plugin when needed.
For libraries, add vite-plugin-dts for declaration output.
Verify with nx run <project>:build and nx run <project>:test.
NEVER skip nxViteTsPaths() in Nx monorepos.
NEVER bundle all dependencies in library mode; ALWAYS externalize peer dependencies for published libraries.
NEVER use project-relative cache or coverage paths that ignore the workspace root.
NEVER mix unrelated build and test concerns without intention; keep sections intentional and validate each step.
ALWAYS define test.reporters, test.environment and deterministic cache and coverage paths.
